text:
marie: Heads up — our partner archival bucket (gs://partner-archives) contains ~900 objects still encrypted with the deprecated KMS key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/deprecated-v1`. We need a controlled unwrap/rewrap + compliance audit. Not an emergency but high priority for partner contracts.
devin: blast radius? only archives, or anything live?
marie: archives only (cold storage), plus some Vault transit entries that use the same key for a legacy transit key. No active prod writes, but partner replay jobs could try reads.
rana: proposal: 1) create a temporary service account `kms-rotation-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 2) allow decrypt on deprecated key only to that SA 3) run small-scale rewrap workflow -> write new ciphertext to a new bucket prefix 4) swap pointers / update metadata 5) revoke decrypt and retire key.
devin: agree. We should also turn on KMS audit export to security logs before mass work. We need 180d of access records for compliance.
ops-bot: created ticket SEC-4821 and scheduled a maintenance window candidate: 2026-03-28 02:00-04:00 UTC.
marie: thanks. Who can own the tooling for blob rewrap and metadata update? I can own coordination and partner comms. Devin can we get the script?
devin: I’ll own the script. Will build idempotent worker that streams the manifest and does: decrypt -> encrypt with new key -> write rewrapped blob -> update DB/metadata. Example sketch: ```python
# pseudo
for row in manifest:
  plaintext = kms.decrypt(row.ciphertext, key='deprecated-v1')
  new_cipher = kms.encrypt(plaintext, key='partner-v2')
  storage.write(row.bucket, row.path.replace('archives/','archives-rewrapped/'), new_cipher)
  metadata.update(row.id, {'rewrapped': True, 'rewrap_ts': now()})
```
rana: on RBAC: do NOT remove decrypt from the old key until rewrap-runner completes. Also add a conditional deny for `cryptoKeys.encrypt` on deprecated-v1 to prevent new encrypts. We'll add a short-lived IAM deny binding for `allUsers`/others.
marie: good note. Also need a Vault plan: some secrets are transit-wrapped using `transit/keys/legacy-partner`. We must perform `vault write transit/rewrap` for those secrets and test consumers. Rana, can you coordinate Vault steps?
rana: yes. Test flow: create `transit/keys/partner-v2`, then on test secret run: ```bash
vault write transit/rewrap name=legacy-partner ciphertext="<old>"
```
marie: manifest uploaded to gs://redwood-security/tmp/partner-archive-manifest-3187654321.csv (cols: object_id,bucket,path,last_read,owner_sa). Shared with @devin @rana.
devin: I'll pick 25 objects for a canary and post results. If canary passes, run full job in maintenance window.
auditor: please ensure audit capture includes: principalEmail, methodName, resourceName, timestamp, and requestMetadata.requestAttributes.correlationId. We will run queries and attach to SEC-4821.
marie: can we schedule the canary tonight at 23:30 UTC? Need partner POC on standby.
devin: I can do 23:30 UTC canary. Plan: pick objects with last_read > 60d so low traffic.
rana: I'll prepare an IAM change plan: 1) add deny for encrypt on deprecated-v1 2) grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to rewrap-runner@... 3) after successful rewrap, revoke decrypt and mark key for scheduled destruction in 30d per policy.
auditor: also require we snapshot KMS key IAM policy before changes and store in s3://redwood-security/audit-snapshots/3187654321-policy.json.
marie: partner comms: short note drafted, will DM partner ops. If their replay jobs hit, they should see read failures during the swap window; we'll provide a curl test they can run.
devin: canary results: 25/25 rewrapped, checksums verified, consumer read test passed. Uploading logs to gs://redwood-security/logs/rewrap-canary-3187654321.txt
rana: Vault rewrap test also OK on test-secret-09. No consumer regressions in staging.
auditor: kicked off KMS audit query (job id: audit-3187654321) for 180d window. Expect output in ~30m to gs://redwood-security/audit-backfill/3187654321.json
marie: excellent. Next: full rewrap tomorrow 02:00 UTC maintenance. Owners: marie (incident lead & partner comms), devin (rewrap tooling + run), rana (IAM/RBAC + Vault steps), auditor (audit capture + compliance artifacts).
devin: posting runbook link: gs://redwood-security/runbooks/partner-rewrap-3187654321.md. Will include expected error codes, retry policy, and how to detect corrupted outputs.
marie: rollback plan: if >0.5% of objects fail checksum or any consumer regression, stop job, restore previous metadata pointers and open SEC-4821-high. Notify partner.
auditor: KMS audit backfill complete. Summary: 12 encrypt calls, 31 decrypt calls from last 180d. Two decrypts attributed to an outdated partner CI SA — opened ticket to rotate that SA and notified partner POC. Full log dump at gs://redwood-security/audit-backfill/3187654321.json
rana: prepping IAM changes now, will apply temporary deny at T-10m before canary tomorrow.
devin: all set on tooling. Will run mass job in the window and stream progress here.
marie: thanks team. After mass run we will: 1) revoke decrypt on deprecated key 2) tag key as retired 3) attach audit artifacts to SEC-4821 and close with partner sign-off. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: SEC-4821 updated: canary ok, maintenance confirmed for 2026-03-28 02:00 UTC.
marie: closing loop — anyone needing temp access for the run, request in #access-requests with reason 'rewrap-run 3187654321'.
